definition: Half of the diameter at 26.5 B mag per square arcsec that Ho et al. (2011) measured for NGC 4696, 10.96 arcmin: 328.8 arcsec at 40.3 Mpc.
presentation: Where the volume ends: while the camera is inside this radius the galaxy's caption hides; outside it the caption hangs under what is drawn of the galaxy. Not a boundary of the galaxy.
